title: Part 6 — In Your Own Words
instructions: Answer as honestly as you can. There are no wrong answers here, and this is just to help me support you better. The last question is optional.

questions.prompt: Overall, how are you feeling about the class so far?
Which topic so far has been the hardest for you, and what specifically is confusing about it? (It's fine to say "none.")
Which topic do you feel most confident about?
Is there anything about the pace, the homework, or the classwork you would change? If so, what?
What is one thing that would help you learn better in this class?
Anything else you'd like me to know? (optional)
